stories.story_title: How Podium Armed 10,000+ Local Businesses with AI Agents
stories.why_this_story: Demonstrates the real-world deployment of autonomous AI agents outside of tech corporations, touching over 10,000 main street businesses.
stories.viral_angle: AI agents are no longer a silicon valley prototype—they are already running local main street businesses.
stories.story_sentence: Everyone thinks AI agents are just experimental code for tech labs, but 10,000+ local businesses are already using an AI teammate called Jerry to drive real growth.
stories.story_arc: Hook → Setup → Tension → Reveal → Consequence → Payoff

design.visual_strategy: Editorial layout with high contrast typography and oversized numerical data markers emphasizing scale without relying on unverified screenshots.
design.retention_strategy: Open a narrative loop about AI replacing manual front-desk work on Main Street, scaling up to the verified growth figures.

source_story.title: How Podium is arming 10,000+ SMBs with AI agents

slides.headline: THE AI AGENT ON MAIN STREET.
slides.body: While everyone debates artificial general intelligence, 10,000 local businesses quietly assigned customer service to an AI teammate.
slides.visual_concept: Bold asymmetric headline layout with understated editorial frame and clean metadata tag.
slides.context: Main Street deployment of AI agents.
slides.implication: AI agents are actively entering small business operations today.
slides.swipe_reason: Creates an information gap on how local businesses are actually using AI.
slides.psychological_goal: Stop the scroll by challenging the assumption that AI agents are only for big tech.

slides.headline: MEET 'JERRY'.
slides.body: Podium integrated OpenAI models to build an autonomous teammate designed specifically for small and medium-sized businesses.
slides.visual_concept: Minimalist quote block introducing the concept of an AI teammate managing customer interaction.
slides.context: Podium introduced an AI teammate called Jerry built with OpenAI technology.
slides.implication: Software platforms are transforming into agentic labor networks.
slides.swipe_reason: Makes the viewer curious about what this AI teammate actually accomplishes.
slides.psychological_goal: Validate the initial hook and deepen curiosity.

slides.body: More than 10,000 small and medium businesses have deployed Jerry to automate and transform how they handle customer communications.
slides.visual_concept: Massive stat callout displaying 10,000+ SMBs with sharp grid lines and subtle gold accents.
slides.context: Verified scale of deployment across small business networks.
slides.implication: Agentic AI adoption is occurring faster in practical SMB workflows than expected.
slides.swipe_reason: Presents scale metrics that justify the claim made on slide 1.
slides.psychological_goal: Establish concrete proof of widespread real-world adoption.

slides.headline: FROM CHATBOT TO TEAMMATE.
slides.body: Instead of static auto-replies, the system handles complex customer workflows natively, directly interfacing with business backends.
slides.visual_concept: A structured 3-step sequence showing: Customer Inquiry → AI Processing → Business Action.
slides.context: The transition from basic chatbot responses to actionable AI agency.
slides.implication: Small business software is shifting from passive tools to active workforce multipliers.
slides.swipe_reason: Explains the underlying shift in technology capability.
slides.psychological_goal: Build narrative tension by demonstrating how significantly operations change.

slides.body: GROWTH REPORTED IN SMALL BUSINESS CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT AND RESPONSE CONVERSION.
slides.visual_concept: High-contrast inverted black slide featuring an explosive green-accented 300% metric display.
slides.context: Podium reports up to 300% growth metrics connected to AI teammate deployment.
slides.implication: AI agents provide measurable ROI for non-technical enterprises.
slides.swipe_reason: Visual rhythm break forces immediate focus on the ROI headline.
slides.psychological_goal: Deliver a dramatic pattern interrupt that highlights the real-world payoff.

slides.headline: THIS MEANS...
slides.body: The real battle for AI utility isn't happening in high-tech labs. It is happening in local auto shops, clinics, and service businesses scaling with autonomous labor.
slides.visual_concept: Clean two-column analysis block contrasting enterprise hype with main street reality.
slides.context: Analytical perspective on the democratized distribution of AI capabilities.
slides.implication: Local businesses adopting agents early gain a major operational advantage.
slides.swipe_reason: Answers the key question: 'Why does this matter to the broader tech industry?'

slides.headline: AGENTS ARE ALREADY HERE.
slides.body: The future of work isn't just about replacing code—it's about every local business operating with AI-powered teammates.
slides.visual_concept: Minimalist editorial resolution with prominent brand mark and clean concluding typography.
slides.context: Concluding takeaways on agent adoption across local commerce.
slides.implication: Expect agentic AI integrations to become standard across all SaaS platforms.
slides.swipe_reason: Leaves the reader with a definitive takeaway worth sharing.

stories.caption:
While the internet debates when AI agents will arrive, over 10,000 local businesses are already using one.

Podium integrated OpenAI’s GPT-5 models to build 'Jerry'—an autonomous AI teammate handling customer service and operations for local businesses. The result? Up to 300% growth in engagement.

The biggest AI shift isn't just happening in Silicon Valley. It's happening on Main Street.
